description: Read your WHOOP recovery, sleep, strain, and workouts to understand daily readiness and historical trends.
example_prompts: Show my latest recovery and the sleep associated with it.
Compare my recovery and sleep over the last two weeks, noting missing or unscored days.
Show my workouts from the past week with strain and heart-rate zones.
Confirm which WHOOP account is connected and show my body measurements.
anything_else: Read-only official WHOOP v2 API. OAuth is configured; personal data access requires WHOOP account consent. No journal, private mobile APIs, or medical diagnosis.

authentication.credential: WHOOP browser authorization; MCP-issued bearer token managed by the client
authentication.configuration: Add the MCP URL using your client's built-in or platform-managed OAuth connector setup. Let the client register its callback and securely manage tokens. Hosted clients should use a platform HTTPS callback; localhost requires an active listener reachable from the browser. Authorize your WHOOP account, then verify with whoop_get_profile and a data read. Never put credentials in prompts.
authentication.note: OAuth is configured. Credentials are encrypted server-side for refresh; requested health records are sent to your MCP client but are not stored by this connector.

technical_specs.discovery: Standard MCP tools/list after OAuth; public documentation describes all tools.
